scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/types build && bun run --workspaces --if-present build
scripts.test: bun run test:types && bun run test:ts:node && bun run test:packages && bun run --cwd packages/cli test
scripts.test:ts:node: tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/crud/tsconfig.json && node --test dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/adapter-compat.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/cross-wire.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/payload-robustness.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/field-order-drift.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/generated-client.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/runtime-contract.test.js dist-ts/examples/calculator/ts/transport-bench.test.js dist-ts/examples/crud/ts/*.test.js
scripts.test:types: bun run --cwd packages/types build && bun run --cwd packages/types test
scripts.test:packages: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/node test && bun run --cwd packages/bun test && bun run --cwd packages/tauri test && bun run --cwd packages/react-native test && bun run --cwd packages/testing test && bun run --cwd packages/devtools test && bun run --cwd packages/react test
scripts.test:ts:bun: cargo build -p rustra-calculator-example -q && bun test examples/calculator/ts/*.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime:node: cargo build -p rustra-calculator-example && tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/calculator/apps/node-app.js
scripts.test:runtime:node-napi: bun run build:napi && tsc -p examples/calculator/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/calculator/apps/node-napi-app.js
scripts.test:runtime:tauri: bun run --cwd examples/tauri-calculator build && bun run --cwd examples/tauri-calculator smoke
scripts.test:adapters: bun run test:adapter:tauri && bun run test:adapter:react-native && bun run test:app:react-native
scripts.test:runtime: bun run test:runtime:node && bun run test:runtime:bun && bun run test:runtime:tauri
scripts.test:runtime:native: bun run test:runtime:node-napi && bun run test:runtime:bun-ffi
scripts.test:compat: bun run test:ts:node && bun run test:ts:bun && bun run test:adapters && bun run test:runtime
scripts.test:app:streaming: cargo build -p rustra-streaming-example && tsc -p examples/streaming/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/streaming/apps/node-app.js
scripts.test:app:auth: cargo build -p rustra-auth-example && tsc -p examples/auth/tsconfig.json && node dist-ts/examples/auth/apps/node-app.js
scripts.test:app:reference: cargo build -p rustra-crud-example && tsc -p examples/reference-app/tsconfig.json && node examples/reference-app/dist/examples/reference-app/src/main.js
scripts.coverage:ts: bun run --cwd packages/types test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/node test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/bun test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/tauri test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/react-native test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/testing test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/devtools test:compile && bun run --cwd packages/react test:compile && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcovonly node --test packages/types/dist-test/index.test.js packages/node/dist-test/index.test.js packages/bun/dist-test/index.test.js packages/tauri/dist-test/index.test.js packages/react-native/dist-test/index.test.js packages/testing/dist-test/index.test.js packages/devtools/dist-test/index.test.js packages/react/dist-test/index.test.js
scripts.release: bun run build && bunx changeset publish
